visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a macro close-up of wooden chopsticks lifting a piece of translucent, pale-green pickled cabbage topped with a sharp, bright red chili slice against a clean, neutral-colored background. The scene quickly cuts to a pair of hands wearing translucent plastic gloves carefully arranging piles of the pickled cabbage and orange carrot sticks onto a small, round wooden plate under bright studio lighting. (2) The scene shifts to a large glass bowl resting on a wooden tabletop, where the gloved hands are shown tearing apart a fresh head of cabbage into irregular, bite-sized pieces. A small glass vessel is then used to pour white granular salt over the cabbage, and the hands begin to mix and toss the salt thoroughly into the leaves to initiate the traditional dehydration process. (3) In a high-detail sequence, the hands vigorously squeeze clumps of the salted cabbage to extract excess moisture, with beads of water clearly visible dripping back into the glass bowl. Following this, thin slices of orange carrots are poured from a separate small dish into the large bowl, creating a striking visual contrast between the orange and pale green vegetables. (4) The scene transitions to a separate mixing bowl where white sugar and a light yellow liquid (vinegar) are combined and stirred with a pink silicone spatula into a clear dressing. Slices of red chili and finely minced white garlic are then added to the liquid, with the camera capturing the vibrant colors being integrated into the mixture. (5) The prepared cabbage and carrots are tossed by hand into the spicy dressing bowl to ensure every piece is thoroughly infused with the sweet, sour, and spicy flavors. Finally, the mixture is transferred into a clear plastic storage container, followed by several cinematic close-up shots of the finished Taiwanese pickled cabbage served on a rustic wooden plate.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with upbeat, major-key acoustic pop music featuring a rhythmic guitar and steady percussion. A male narrator introduces the recipe with a warm, energetic tone, accompanied by the high-frequency rustling of fresh cabbage leaves. (2) As the narrator continues his instructional delivery at a moderate pace, the sound of granular salt being poured creates a brief pitter-patter sound. The BGM provides a consistent background energy during the initial vegetable preparation. (3) A prominent sequence of wet, rhythmic squishing sounds is heard as the narrator explains the process of removing water from the cabbage. These mid-frequency sounds are crisp and clear, synchronized with the speaker's enthusiastic descriptions. (4) The sound of a thin liquid splashing into a glass bowl marks the addition of vinegar, followed by the rhythmic scraping of a spatula against the glass surface. Short impact transients are audible as minced garlic and chili slices are dropped into the mixing bowl. (5) The speaker's voice reaches its highest arousal during the final tossing of the ingredients, accompanied by splashing and handling sounds. The upbeat BGM maintains its presence before a gentle fade-out at the video's conclusion.
